mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_code AS workerId, full_name AS fullName, phone_number AS phoneNumber, password_hash AS passwordHash, status, is_online AS online, vehicle_type AS vehicleType, vehicle_number AS vehicleNumber FROM delivery_app_workers WHERE worker_code = #{workerId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, worker_code AS workerId, full_name AS fullName, phone_number AS phoneNumber, status, is_online AS online, vehicle_type AS vehicleType, vehicle_number AS vehicleNumber FROM delivery_app_workers WHERE worker_code = #{workerId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_app_workers(worker_code, full_name, phone_number, password_hash, status, is_online, vehicle_type, vehicle_number, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{workerId}, #{fullName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{password}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{vehicleType}, #{vehicleNumber}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_code AS workerId, full_name AS fullName, phone_number AS phoneNumber, status, is_online AS online, vehicle_type AS vehicleType, vehicle_number AS vehicleNumber FROM delivery_app_workers ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_app_workers SET is_online = #{online}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{workerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO delivery_jobs (order_id, customer_name, customer_phone, delivery_address, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT o.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''), 'Mijoz'), COALESCE(NULLIF(u.phone_number, ''), ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(o.delivery_address, ''), NULLIF(u.address, ''), 'Manzil ko''rsatilmagan'), 'WAITING_ASSIGNMENT', NOW(), NOW() FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id=o.user_id WHERE o.payment_status='PAID' AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PREPARING','READY','ON_THE_WAY')
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery_jobs dj JOIN orders o ON o.id=dj.order_id WHERE dj.delivery_worker_id IS NULL AND dj.status='WAITING_ASSIGNMENT' AND o.payment_status='PAID' AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','DELIVERED')) AS availableCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery_jobs WHERE delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} AND (status IN ('ACCEPTED','ON_THE_WAY') OR (status='FAILED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.id=delivery_jobs.order_id AND o.status='RETURNING')))) AS activeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivery_jobs WHERE delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} AND status='DELIVERED' AND DATE(delivered_at)=CURRENT_DATE()) AS completedTodayCount

SELECT dj.id AS jobId, o.id AS orderId, o.order_number AS orderNumber, dj.customer_name AS customerName, NULL AS customerPhone, dj.delivery_address AS deliveryAddress, dj.status AS jobStatus, o.status AS orderStatus, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, o.total_price AS totalPrice, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0) AS productCount, DATE_FORMAT(dj.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM delivery_jobs dj JOIN orders o ON o.id=dj.order_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE dj.delivery_worker_id IS NULL AND dj.status='WAITING_ASSIGNMENT' AND o.payment_status='PAID' AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','DELIVERED') GROUP BY dj.id,o.id,o.order_number,dj.customer_name,dj.delivery_address,dj.status,o.status,o.payment_status,o.total_price,dj.created_at ORDER BY dj.created_at ASC

SELECT dj.id AS jobId, o.id AS orderId, o.order_number AS orderNumber, dj.customer_name AS customerName, dj.customer_phone AS customerPhone, dj.delivery_address AS deliveryAddress, COALESCE(o.delivery_latitude,u.location_latitude) AS locationLatitude, COALESCE(o.delivery_longitude,u.location_longitude) AS locationLongitude, dj.status AS jobStatus, o.status AS orderStatus, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, o.total_price AS totalPrice, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0) AS productCount, DATE_FORMAT(dj.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(dj.accepted_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS acceptedAt, DATE_FORMAT(dj.on_the_way_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS onTheWayAt FROM delivery_jobs dj JOIN orders o ON o.id=dj.order_id JOIN users u ON u.id=o.user_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE dj.delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} AND (dj.status IN ('ACCEPTED','ON_THE_WAY') OR (dj.status='FAILED' AND o.status='RETURNING')) AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY dj.id,o.id,o.order_number,dj.customer_name,dj.customer_phone,dj.delivery_address,o.delivery_latitude,o.delivery_longitude,u.location_latitude,u.location_longitude,dj.status,o.status,o.payment_status,o.total_price,dj.created_at,dj.accepted_at,dj.on_the_way_at ORDER BY dj.updated_at DESC

SELECT dj.id AS jobId, o.id AS orderId, o.order_number AS orderNumber, dj.customer_name AS customerName, dj.customer_phone AS customerPhone, dj.delivery_address AS deliveryAddress, dj.status AS jobStatus, o.status AS orderStatus, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, o.total_price AS totalPrice, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0) AS productCount, DATE_FORMAT(dj.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(dj.delivered_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS deliveredAt, dj.note FROM delivery_jobs dj JOIN orders o ON o.id=dj.order_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE dj.delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} AND dj.status IN ('DELIVERED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND o.status <> 'RETURNING' GROUP BY dj.id,o.id,o.order_number,dj.customer_name,dj.customer_phone,dj.delivery_address,dj.status,o.status,o.payment_status,o.total_price,dj.created_at,dj.delivered_at,dj.note ORDER BY dj.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT dj.id AS jobId, o.id AS orderId, o.order_number AS orderNumber, dj.customer_name AS customerName, CASE WHEN dj.delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} THEN dj.customer_phone ELSE NULL END AS customerPhone, dj.delivery_address AS deliveryAddress, CASE WHEN dj.delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} THEN COALESCE(o.delivery_latitude,u.location_latitude) ELSE NULL END AS locationLatitude, CASE WHEN dj.delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} THEN COALESCE(o.delivery_longitude,u.location_longitude) ELSE NULL END AS locationLongitude, dj.status AS jobStatus, o.status AS orderStatus, o.payment_status AS paymentStatus, o.total_price AS totalPrice, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM order_items WHERE order_id=o.id) AS productCount, DATE_FORMAT(dj.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(dj.accepted_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS acceptedAt, DATE_FORMAT(dj.on_the_way_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS onTheWayAt, DATE_FORMAT(dj.delivered_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS deliveredAt, dj.note FROM delivery_jobs dj JOIN orders o ON o.id=dj.order_id JOIN users u ON u.id=o.user_id WHERE dj.id=#{jobId} AND (dj.delivery_worker_id IS NULL OR dj.delivery_worker_id=#{workerId}) LIMIT 1

SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.product_image_url AS productImageUrl, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.quantity, oi.total_price AS totalPrice FROM delivery_jobs dj JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=dj.order_id WHERE dj.id=#{jobId} ORDER BY oi.id
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_jobs SET delivery_worker_id=#{workerId}, status='ACCEPTED', accepted_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND delivery_worker_id IS NULL AND status='WAITING_ASSIGNMENT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.id=delivery_jobs.order_id AND o.payment_status='PAID' AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','DELIVERED'))
mapper.select: SELECT dj.status FROM delivery_jobs dj JOIN orders o ON o.id=dj.order_id WHERE dj.id=#{jobId} AND dj.delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_jobs dj JOIN orders o ON o.id=dj.order_id SET dj.status=#{status}, dj.note=#{note}, dj.on_the_way_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='ON_THE_WAY' THEN NOW() ELSE dj.on_the_way_at END, dj.delivered_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='DELIVERED' THEN NOW() ELSE dj.delivered_at END, dj.updated_at=NOW() WHERE dj.id=#{jobId} AND dj.delivery_worker_id=#{workerId} AND o.status IN ('READY','ON_THE_WAY') AND ((#{status}='ON_THE_WAY' AND dj.status='ACCEPTED' AND o.status='READY') OR (#{status}='DELIVERED' AND dj.status='ON_THE_WAY' AND o.status='ON_THE_WAY') OR (#{status}='FAILED' AND dj.status IN ('ACCEPTED','ON_THE_WAY')))

UPDATE orders o JOIN delivery_jobs dj ON dj.order_id=o.id SET o.status_actor=CASE WHEN #{auditActor}='SYSTEM' THEN CONCAT('COURIER:',dj.delivery_worker_id) ELSE #{auditActor} END,o.status_source='COURIER', o.status_reason=CASE WHEN #{orderStatus}='RETURNING' THEN dj.note ELSE NULL END, o.status=#{orderStatus}, o.delivered_at=CASE WHEN #{orderStatus}='DELIVERED' THEN NOW() ELSE o.delivered_at END, o.updated_at=NOW() WHERE dj.id=#{jobId} AND ((#{orderStatus}='RETURNING' AND dj.status='FAILED' AND o.status IN ('READY','ON_THE_WAY')) OR (#{orderStatus}='ON_THE_WAY' AND dj.status='ON_THE_WAY' AND o.status IN ('READY','ON_THE_WAY')) OR (#{orderStatus}='DELIVERED' AND dj.status='DELIVERED' AND o.status='ON_THE_WAY'))

UPDATE orders o JOIN delivery_jobs dj ON dj.order_id=o.id SET o.status_actor=CONCAT('COURIER:',dj.delivery_worker_id),o.status_source='COURIER_SYNC', o.status_reason=CASE WHEN dj.status='FAILED' THEN LEFT(dj.note,500) ELSE NULL END, o.status = CASE WHEN dj.status='ACCEPTED' THEN 'READY' WHEN dj.status='ON_THE_WAY' THEN 'ON_THE_WAY' WHEN dj.status='FAILED' THEN 'RETURNING' WHEN dj.status='DELIVERED' THEN 'DELIVERED' ELSE o.status END, o.delivered_at = CASE WHEN dj.status='DELIVERED' AND o.delivered_at IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE o.delivered_at END, o.updated_at=NOW() WHERE dj.id=#{jobId} AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND ((dj.status='ACCEPTED' AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PREPARING','READY')) OR (dj.status='ON_THE_WAY' AND o.status IN ('READY','ON_THE_WAY')) OR (dj.status='DELIVERED' AND o.status IN ('ON_THE_WAY','DELIVERED')) OR (dj.status='FAILED' AND o.status IN ('READY','ON_THE_WAY')))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_job_tracking(delivery_job_id, delivery_worker_id, status, message, created_at) VALUES(#{jobId}, #{workerId}, #{status}, #{message}, NOW())
